card.name: Digits inside postal ZIP codes
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle of a ZIP or postcode, right after the state or city in a mailing address (e.g. DC 2<<0>>005, NY 1<<0>>010). Usually the second digit of a US ZIP code.

modes.label: US ZIP code digit
modes.description: A digit inside a five-digit ZIP code after a city and state in an address or trial site listing.

modes.label: Other postcodes
modes.description: A digit in a UK or Boston-style postcode.
modes.example: Science Oxford, 1-5 London Place, Oxford, OX<<4>> 1BD Tickets: £6
